title: 第八章 我就是那个废物第三更第九章 打赌第四更
content_zh:
“嗯？”
郑阳一愣，脸色一下变得透红，难看。
“我是暗恋一个女孩，然后……被人当面羞辱，可这和老师没什么关系吧！”
他曾经暗恋一个女孩，非常兴奋地前去表白，结果被对方无情的嘲弄、打击，让他受尽屈辱，这件事对他来说是秘密，就连还有莫晓都不知情，这个老师怎么知道？
“真的假的？郑阳，你被人羞辱怎么不告诉我？是谁？”莫晓听他承认，忍不住一愣，急忙问道。
“这件事我们回头说！”郑阳摇摇头，显然不想在这里多说，抬头看向眼前的老师：“老师，这是我的私事，虽然不知道你如何知晓，但这和指点我的枪法没关系吧！”
“没关系？”张悬摇摇头：“关系很大！”
“有关系？”郑阳满是疑惑。
自己就失恋而已，和让对方指点有什么关系？
“你的枪法刚猛果断，代表了你的性格，做任何事都勇往直前，不去想后路如何！本来这是好事，武者就应该这样，不用瞻前顾后！”张悬神色淡然：“不过，可惜的是，有了这次感情经历，你有些畏惧了，害怕被拒绝，害怕失败，害怕被羞辱！枪法中多出了一些迟疑，多出了一些疑惑！威力也因此大大减弱！”
“你……你……从我的枪法中看出了这些？看出了为曾失恋过？看出了我的性格？”
郑阳吓了一跳。
不是对方说错，而是说的太对了，几乎一点不差。
他性格勇敢果断，以前做什么事都不害怕，正是因为那次感情经历，现在干什么都畏缩不前，犹犹豫豫。
只看自己的枪法，就能看出这些，甚至连失恋都能看出来，这是什么眼力？
学院怎么会有这么厉害的老师？
他都觉得快要疯了。
之前他去拜号称枪法教授第一的王超为师，也展示了绝招，王超看完只说自己枪法不得要领，至于什么原因，却也说不出来，眼前这人只看了一眼，就说自己失恋过，因为感情受挫，才导致枪法裹足不前，难道这位老师的眼力……比王超还要强大？
“这没什么奇怪的！”张悬大手一挥，满脸高人风范：“枪法代表心境，心境不明，施展的武技，自然也阴暗！你的枪法虽然连贯，却好像被什么东西缠绕，斩不断，理还乱，只看了一眼，我就知道肯定是情思！”
“这……”

这次不光郑阳崩溃，就连一侧的莫晓也张大了嘴巴，快要塞下一个鸡蛋。
麻蛋，真的假的？
看枪法，能看出情思缠绕，还斩不断，理还乱……这真是人类的眼睛？
莫晓、郑阳对望一眼，都从各自眼神中看出了不敢相信。
“老师，那你能帮我看看吗？”
震惊过后，莫晓突然向前，一脸渴望，也不管张悬同不同意，手掌长枪一抖，招数也挥洒出来。
同样用枪他的招数明显比一侧的郑阳，更加流畅，威力更大。
单从枪法来看，的确他更胜一筹，难怪王超老师选中了他，而没选上郑阳。
呼！
一阵呼啸风声，莫晓收枪站立。
枪走，如盖世狂魔，力量散佚，神鬼莫近，枪收，静若处子，安静的宛如雕塑。
一出手，一抬足，自成风度。
虽然实力不算太强，依旧是武者一重，但论枪法，已经算得上极为不弱了。
“你肠胃不好，如果没猜错，今天还在拉肚子！”
张悬眼神淡然的看过来。
“啊？”莫晓也一阵哆嗦：“老师，你从我枪法中看出了我拉肚子？”
和对方说的一样，他肠胃的确不太好，昨天开始就有些拉肚子了，今天更为严重，身体甚至有些脱力。
不过，这对他没太大影响，长枪在手，他施展出了最完美的状态，就连王超老师都赞不绝口，没说什么，眼前这位，却一开口就说出了要害……
真的假的？
看枪法，连失恋、拉肚子都能看出来，这是什么眼力？

“你让我指点吗？如果让我指点，就拜师吧！”
不理会二人震惊，张悬神色淡然的看过来。
一口说出二人的情况，让二人震惊的快要发疯，但在他看来，好像什么都算不上一样。
事实上也正是这样，二人一炼武技，天到图书馆就自动出现了二人的书籍，所谓的失恋、拉肚子，都是他们现在的缺点，都被记录在上面，张悬只要看上一眼，照本宣科的念出来即可，当然没什么难度了。
“徒儿郑阳，愿意拜老师为师！”
content_en:
"Huh?"
Zheng Yang was stunned for a moment, and his face suddenly turned red and ugly.
"I had a crush on a girl, and then... I was humiliated in front of someone, but this has nothing to do with the teacher!"
He once had a crush on a girl, and he went to express his love to her very excitedly. As a result, he was ridiculed and beaten mercilessly, which made him suffer humiliation. This matter was a secret to him. Even Mo Xiao didn't know about it. How did the teacher know?
"Really or not? Zheng Yang, why didn't you tell me that you were humiliated? Who was it?" Mo Xiao couldn't help being stunned when he heard his admission, and asked hurriedly.
"We'll talk about this later!" Zheng Yang shook his head, obviously not wanting to say more here, and looked up at the teacher in front of him: "Teacher, this is my private matter. I don't know how you know about it, but it has nothing to do with teaching me how to shoot!"
"It doesn't matter?" Zhang Xuan shook his head: "It matters a lot!"
"Does it matter?" Zheng Yang was full of doubts.
I'm just falling out of love, what does it have to do with letting the other person give me advice?
"Your marksmanship is fierce and decisive, which represents your character. You move forward bravely in everything you do, without thinking about the way back! Originally this is a good thing, and warriors should be like this, without looking forward or backward!" Zhang Xuan looked indifferent: "However, it is a pity that after this emotional experience, you are a little afraid, afraid of rejection, fear of failure, fear of being humiliated! There is more hesitation and doubt in the marksmanship! The power is greatly weakened as a result!"
"You...you...see this from my shooting skills? Do you see that I have lost love? Do you see my character?"
Zheng Yang was startled.
It’s not that what the other party said was wrong, it’s that what he said was so right, almost exactly the same.
He has a courageous and decisive character. He was not afraid of anything in the past. It is precisely because of that emotional experience that he is now timid and hesitant in everything he does.
You can see all this just by looking at your own marksmanship, you can even see a broken love. What kind of eyesight is this?
How come there are such great teachers in the college?
He felt like he was going crazy.
Before, he went to study with Wang Chao, who was known as the number one professor of marksmanship, and showed off his unique skills. Wang Chao only said that his marksmanship was incompetent after reading it. As for the reason, he couldn't tell. The man in front of him only took one look and said that he had been in love and was frustrated in his marksmanship. Could it be that this teacher's eyesight... is stronger than Wang Chao's?
"There's nothing strange about this!" Zhang Xuan waved his hand and said with a masterly look on his face: "Marksmanship represents the state of mind. If the state of mind is unknown, the martial arts skills used are naturally dark! Although your marksmanship is coherent, it seems to be entangled with something. It keeps cutting and is still confusing. After just one glance, I knew it must be emotions!"
"This..."
Not only did Zheng Yang collapse this time, but Mo Xiao on one side also opened his mouth wide and was about to stuff an egg into his mouth.
Damn it, is it true?
Looking at the marksmanship, one can see that the emotions are entangled, the cutting continues, and the reasoning is still confused... Are these really human eyes?
Mo Xiao and Zheng Yang looked at each other and couldn't believe it in their eyes.
"Teacher, can you help me take a look?"
After the shock, Mo Xiao suddenly moved forward with a look of desire. Regardless of whether Zhang Xuantong agreed or not, he flicked the spear in his palm and unleashed his moves.
Similarly, his moves with a gun are obviously smoother and more powerful than Zheng Yang's on one side.
Judging from the marksmanship alone, he is indeed better. No wonder Teacher Wang Chao chose him instead of Zheng Yang.
call!
There was a whistling wind, and Mo Xiao put away his gun and stood up.
When the gun is gone, it is like a madman, its power is gone, and gods and ghosts are not close. When the gun is put away, it is as quiet as a virgin, as quiet as a sculpture.
With one move, one move, one has his own style.
Although his strength is not too strong, he is still a first-level warrior, but in terms of marksmanship, he is already extremely strong.
"You have a bad gastrointestinal condition. If I guess correctly, you still have diarrhea today!"
Zhang Xuan looked over with indifferent eyes.
"Ah?" Mo Xiao also shivered: "Teacher, did you notice from my marksmanship that I have diarrhea? "
As the other party said, his stomach and intestines are indeed not very good. He had some diarrhea since yesterday, and today it is even more serious, and his body is even a little exhausted.
However, this did not have much impact on him. With the spear in hand, he showed his best performance. Even Teacher Wang Chao was full of praise. He didn't say anything, but the person in front of him said the key point as soon as he opened his mouth...
Real or fake?
Looking at the marksmanship, one can even detect broken love and diarrhea. What kind of eyesight is this?
"Do you want me to give you advice? If you want me to give you advice, then become a disciple! "
Ignoring the shock of the two, Zhang Xuan looked over with a calm expression.
Telling the situation of the two of them in one breath made them almost crazy with shock, but in his opinion, it seemed like it was nothing.
In fact, this is exactly what happened. As soon as the two practiced martial arts, their books automatically appeared in the library. The so-called lovelorn and diarrhea were all their current shortcomings, and they were all recorded in them. Zhang Xuan only had to take a look at them and read them out as written. Of course, there was no difficulty.
"My disciple Zheng Yang is willing to become my teacher! "
